townsperson_a.name: Townsperson
lines: Have you heard? The bridge north of town is broken.

townsperson_b.name: Townsperson
lines: Cornelia used to be such a peaceful place...
I hope the Warriors of Light can save us.

townsperson_c.name: Old Man
lines: I've lived in Cornelia for sixty years.
Never seen times as dark as these.
